scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.ios:add: npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.tizen:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-tv.mjs tizen
scripts.webos:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-tv.mjs webos
scripts.electron:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-tv.mjs electron
